en: Sepia-toned street view of a European town, showing multi‑story residential and commercial buildings with ornate facades on both sides of a wide street. Young trees line the sidewalks, and three children with school satchels walk in the foreground at right. In the distance, more historic buildings and a church-like tower are visible. The caption at the top identifies the location as Olbernhau and the street as Albertstraße; additional German shop and building signs are visible on the left side further down the street.
